prompt: I keep having to give Claude the same correction every session — it writes migrations without a rollback step. I've told it like six times. how do I make it stick
expected_output: Turns a recurring correction into a durable rule that survives — rule plus precedent plus self-check — rather than suggesting he just add a line to CLAUDE.md.
assertions: Produces the actual rule text, not advice about writing rules
Includes something that makes the rule verifiable or self-checking, not just a statement
Explains why bare imperatives decay and what makes one survive
Addresses where it should live so it is actually loaded when relevant
